segments.name: Artwork/collectables trading
products: China International Assets and Equity of Artworks Exchange Limited
segments.description: Operates an online platform facilitating trading of collectibles, artwork and certain commodities for individual and institutional customers.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Company determined that it has only one operating segment and therefore one reportable segment as defined by ASC 280, which is facilitating e-commerce of artwork/collectables trading.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from facilitating customer trading of collectibles and artwork on its platform, and from marketing, storage and technical maintenance services to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: We also provide online and offline integrated marketing, storage and technical maintenance services to our customers in China.

changes.text: In 2024 the HKDAEx trading platform ceased operation and the Company sold HKDAEx in December 2024.
changes.evidence: The trading platform of HKDAEx and its related trading business ceased operation as of June 30, 2024 and the Company sold HKDAEx to an unrelated party for $1 in December 2024.
